The angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection — this is correct.

The other two statements are not true: "The image in a plane mirror is always magnified" and "A convex mirror always forms a real image" both misstate the physics.

So only II is correct.

"The image formed by a plane mirror is real and inverted" is the incorrect statement.
